contract: Resolve exactly one terminal base and registered companion; require the exact adjacent N16 migration receipt for every all-Q4, mixed, or four-role base and carry its normalized source, output-plan, transcoder, and receipt identities; retain the selected chunk, G16/G32 cache, dense/XAttention Text-prefill build, dense DFlash proposal/verification, directly bound Q4G64 draft matrices with A8G64 activations, source-BF16 non-matrix/codebook objects, and separate private fixed-BF16 runtime state. The source model/config/README and runtime config/state/layout authorities are hash-bound and revalidated before any benchmark. Four-role alone additionally requires its hybrid selection, index/ranking, planner, and workspace authorities.
staging: Validate the terminal route and completed companion first; run the fixed C1 shortlist; derive rather than enter its non-dominated K/W frontier; run ordered C1..4 capacity for every frontier tuple; run the 18-point DFlash Pareto matrix only for capacity-eligible tuples; then durably publish one atomic no-overwrite schema-v2 selection. Quality/parity/determinism, acceptance, capacity, and whole throughput remain separate inputs to the selection rule; this evaluation selection is not final artifact admission.
hybrid_rule: If and only if the four-role base wins and its companion is absent, first append the registered 66 DFlash objects to the exact selected base with the authority-bound converter and preserve its selected hybrid workspace planner. Every existing or new companion is reopened and its exact ordered 1,190-object directory must equal the current converter preflight; the hybrid base authority is normalized from the selected receipt and must equal the conversion report's base authority. No losing companion is measured.
hybrid_runner_contract: The shared runner now admits --require-fp8-hybrid only for dflash-shortlist, dflash-capacity, and dflash-pareto; validates the hybrid-DFlash companion through its conversion report and base.authority back to the selected four-role receipt; retains the hybrid-width-tool workspace proof; and covers the exact C1 shortlist plus ordered C1..4 capacity/Pareto cases while rejecting other presets and non-hybrid companions. This closes command support only. A four-role DFlash run remains blocked until schema-v7 selects that base, its companion is materialized, the selected-DFlash preparation is regenerated against the winner, and the physical commands are explicitly authorized.
